name: Awaburo Experience
original_name: 泡風呂エクスペリエンス
source:
Our hero took his very first trip to a soapland, but passed out as soon as he came.
His next challenge: to enjoy the soapland experience to the fullest!

YOU are that hero! Visit different establishments to build up your stamina.

"Wanna do it in the elevator?"
"Is the bathroom okay?"
"You want me to wash you somewhere else?
"In the bath? On the mat? How about in bed?"

Your devoted companion Nadia will help you on your journey toward becoming a Soap Master!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ214480.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我们的英雄第一次去肥皂剧，但一到就昏倒了。
他的下一个挑战：充分享受肥皂剧体验！

你就是那个英雄！参观不同的场所来增强你的耐力。

“想在电梯里做吗？”
“卫生间还好吗？”
“要我去别的地方给你洗澡吗？
“洗澡的时候？在垫子上？床上怎么样？”

你忠诚的伴侣娜迪亚将帮助你踏上成为肥皂大师的旅程！”

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ214480.html/]DLsite英文[/url]]
